findings.what: Both dispatch bridges continue when deriveBinding() returns ok:false for non-President-leak failures such as corrupt role-binding control, ED-220 value invalidity, or unknown role values.
findings.why: A2 requires a BLOCK/fail-closed binding to refuse dispatch pre-spawn. As written, the live bridge only exits for reason text matching President/category-error and otherwise spawns an unbound worker with only WARPOS_ACTOR_KIND stamped, making the resolver's fail-closed result advisory instead of binding.

findings.what: top_level_human_default is validated only as a non-empty string, and deriveBinding({channel:'session-bootstrap'}) will return ok:true with an arbitrary bogus boundRole.
findings.why: ED-220 and the QA plan require unknown/out-of-registry/malformed role values to BLOCK. The warm helm path can bind a made-up top-level role, and there is no negative fixture asserting this value check.

findings.what: Adding verdict to SIGNED_FIELDS changes the canonical HMAC string even when verdict is absent.
findings.why: Newly signed no-verdict records verify, but records signed by the previous field set with no verdict will now fail verifyRecord and be demoted as unsigned when CLI requireSignature is on. The compatibility claim is only true for records signed after this change.

parsed.summary: Required fixtures for derived-not-settable and default-binding plant are present, conformance-matrix extraction still passes its 55-test suite, and the new signing tests cover forged unsigned and verdict-flip cases. The verdict is FAIL because the live dispatch bridges do not enforce deriveBinding ok:false generally, and ED-220 top-level role value validation is hollow on the warm helm path.
